Package org.geysermc.paletter.creative

Class CreativeLayout

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.creative.CreativeLayout
public final class CreativeLayout extends Object
An immutable, version independent creative inventory layout: per category, an ordered list of groups and loose stacks.

This is the model, not the wire format. The protocol has no notion of "loose" stacks; it only knows a flat list of groups (unnamed ones for loose runs), each item pointing at a group index, and it crashes on empty groups. CreativeContent handles that translation per client version, so none of it leaks into the layout.

Since:
1.0.0
